name: reboot-recover
effect: arm: writes the root-owned marker /var/lib/himmel/reboot-recover.json (operator user, handover doc, repo) and installs the user unit himmel-recover.service for every user session; after the next login it checks the services, verifies the Telegram bridge, re-arms the chief from <doc> and sends a status, once per arming. disarm: removes the marker, so a later login does nothing. With no marker the unit does not start
